biggest_catch: The $100 reward is stock/ETF that cannot be withdrawn for 12 months (withdrawing early can trigger a $100 fee), and you must claim it within 30 days. Overall cap is $500 in referral rewards.
catches: $100 in a stock or ETF of your choice per qualifying referral; maximum $500 of rewards through promotions and offers on the Public app.
Friend must deposit at least $1,000 as a one-time initial deposit (their own money into their own brokerage account).
Reward must be claimed within 30 days of being cleared; expired rewards cannot be revived.
The cash value of the reward may not be withdrawn for 12 months after it is claimed, or your account may be subject to an early withdrawal fee of up to $100.
Referrer must have a funded Public brokerage account in good standing and may only refer personal friends/family members (no spam, commercial advertising, or public sale of referral codes).
Program term began January 20, 2026; Public can change or terminate it at any time without notice.

steps: Open the Public app, tap the Rewards button, and copy your unique referral link.
Send the link to a friend or family member who doesn't have a Public brokerage account.
Your friend signs up via your link, gets approved, and deposits at least $1,000 as a one-time initial deposit.
When Public alerts you that you're cleared, claim your $100 stock/ETF reward within 30 days (max $500 in rewards through promotions).
